data.one_liner: Code generator for rx_bloc that eliminates boilerplate code.
data.what_it_does: Generates zero-boilerplate implementations for rx_bloc classes by analyzing event and state definitions. It automatically creates subjects, inputs, events, and dispose methods based on custom annotations.
use_when: You are building an app using the rx_bloc state management pattern.
You want to remove repetitive boilerplate code for handling bloc inputs, outputs, and disposal.
avoid_when: you are not using the rx_bloc package for state management.
You prefer writing your BLoC or stream boilerplate manually without a code generator.
strengths: Significantly reduces boilerplate for rx_bloc implementations.
Supports event seeding, custom event types, and custom states.
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner to generate files.
Strict adherence to naming conventions and abstract class structures is required.
data.setup_notes: Add rx_bloc_generator and build_runner to dev_dependencies and run build_runner.
